definition.fitted_displacement: argmin_d ||T_{-d} eta_prediction - eta_truth||_2 over the continuous periodic orbit
definition.shape_error: ||T_{-d} prediction - truth||_2 / ||truth||_2, using the elevation-fitted d for every field
definition.threshold_crossing: first saved frame with error strictly greater than threshold
definition.alignment_velocity_identity: for a=S_d p, e=a-y, S_d f(x)=f(x+d): d' = -(<S_d q_p-q_y,a_x>+<e,S_d(q_p)_x>)/(<a_x,a_x>+<e,a_xx>)
